tagline: Optimist who loves to inspire, not just talk
summary: When the cameras are off, Simon is a curious ethnographer who devours books, experiments with new ideas, and mentors quietly. He thrives on human connection, listening more than speaking, and finds joy in the everyday moments that shape culture. His life is a blend of thoughtful reflection and relentless enthusiasm for helping others find their why.
